package serial

import (
	"errors"
	"sync"
	"time"

	"golang.org/x/sys/windows"
)

const (
	probePortHandle  windows.Handle = 400
	probeEventHandle windows.Handle = 401
)

var errProbeUnexpectedReadRetry = errors.New("unexpected ReadFile retry after Close cancellation")

var probeCalls = struct {
	sync.Mutex
	opened                 bool
	readCalls              int
	completionErr          error
	readHandle             windows.Handle
	writeHandle            windows.Handle
	waitHandle             windows.Handle
	cancelHandle           windows.Handle
	closeCount             int
	closedBeforeCompletion bool
	completed              bool
	waitEntered            chan struct{}
	cancelled              chan struct{}
	release                chan struct{}
	holdModeSet            bool
	modeGetHandle          windows.Handle
	modeSetHandle          windows.Handle
	modeSetEntered         chan struct{}
	releaseModeSet         chan struct{}
	modeSetCompleted       bool
	closedBeforeModeSet    bool
	failModeSet            bool
	controlHandle          windows.Handle
	controlFlags           uint32
	controlEntered         chan struct{}
	releaseControl         chan struct{}
	holdControl            bool
	controlCompleted       bool
	closedBeforeControl    bool
	breakSetHandle         windows.Handle
	breakClearHandle       windows.Handle
	breakSetEntered        chan struct{}
	releaseBreakSet        chan struct{}
	breakClearEntered      chan struct{}
	releaseBreakClear      chan struct{}
	breakSetReturnedAt     time.Time
	breakClearEnteredAt    time.Time
	breakArmed             bool
	breakClearCompleted    bool
	closedBeforeBreakClear bool
	timeoutSetCalls        int
	timeoutSetHandle       windows.Handle
}{}

func probeReset() {
	probeCalls.Lock()
	probeCalls.opened = false
	probeCalls.readCalls = 0
	probeCalls.completionErr = windows.ERROR_OPERATION_ABORTED
	probeCalls.readHandle = 0
	probeCalls.writeHandle = 0
	probeCalls.waitHandle = 0
	probeCalls.cancelHandle = 0
	probeCalls.closeCount = 0
	probeCalls.closedBeforeCompletion = false
	probeCalls.completed = false
	probeCalls.waitEntered = make(chan struct{})
	probeCalls.cancelled = make(chan struct{})
	probeCalls.release = make(chan struct{})
	probeCalls.holdModeSet = false
	probeCalls.modeGetHandle = 0
	probeCalls.modeSetHandle = 0
	probeCalls.modeSetEntered = nil
	probeCalls.releaseModeSet = nil
	probeCalls.modeSetCompleted = false
	probeCalls.closedBeforeModeSet = false
	probeCalls.failModeSet = false
	probeCalls.controlHandle = 0
	probeCalls.controlFlags = 0
	probeCalls.controlEntered = nil
	probeCalls.releaseControl = nil
	probeCalls.holdControl = false
	probeCalls.controlCompleted = false
	probeCalls.closedBeforeControl = false
	probeCalls.breakSetHandle = 0
	probeCalls.breakClearHandle = 0
	probeCalls.breakSetEntered = nil
	probeCalls.releaseBreakSet = nil
	probeCalls.breakClearEntered = nil
	probeCalls.releaseBreakClear = nil
	probeCalls.breakSetReturnedAt = time.Time{}
	probeCalls.breakClearEnteredAt = time.Time{}
	probeCalls.breakArmed = false
	probeCalls.breakClearCompleted = false
	probeCalls.closedBeforeBreakClear = false
	probeCalls.timeoutSetCalls = 0
	probeCalls.timeoutSetHandle = 0
	probeCalls.Unlock()
}

func probeHoldBreak() {
	probeCalls.Lock()
	probeCalls.breakSetEntered = make(chan struct{})
	probeCalls.releaseBreakSet = make(chan struct{})
	probeCalls.breakClearEntered = make(chan struct{})
	probeCalls.releaseBreakClear = make(chan struct{})
	probeCalls.Unlock()
}

func probeHoldControl() {
	probeCalls.Lock()
	probeCalls.holdControl = true
	probeCalls.controlEntered = make(chan struct{})
	probeCalls.releaseControl = make(chan struct{})
	probeCalls.Unlock()
}

func probeHoldModeSet() {
	probeCalls.Lock()
	probeCalls.holdModeSet = true
	probeCalls.modeSetEntered = make(chan struct{})
	probeCalls.releaseModeSet = make(chan struct{})
	probeCalls.Unlock()
}

func probeFailModeSet() {
	probeCalls.Lock()
	probeCalls.failModeSet = true
	probeCalls.Unlock()
}

func probeCreateFile(path *uint16, access uint32, share uint32, sa *windows.SecurityAttributes, disposition uint32, flags uint32, template windows.Handle) (windows.Handle, error) {
	probeCalls.Lock()
	probeCalls.opened = true
	probeCalls.Unlock()
	return probePortHandle, nil
}

func probeGetCommState(h windows.Handle, dcb *windows.DCB) error {
	if h != probePortHandle {
		return windows.ERROR_INVALID_HANDLE
	}
	probeCalls.Lock()
	if probeCalls.holdModeSet {
		probeCalls.modeGetHandle = h
	}
	probeCalls.Unlock()
	return nil
}

func probeSetCommState(h windows.Handle, dcb *windows.DCB) error {
	if h != probePortHandle {
		return windows.ERROR_INVALID_HANDLE
	}
	probeCalls.Lock()
	hold := probeCalls.holdModeSet
	fail := probeCalls.failModeSet
	if hold || fail {
		probeCalls.modeSetHandle = h
	}
	probeCalls.Unlock()
	if hold {
		close(probeCalls.modeSetEntered)
		<-probeCalls.releaseModeSet
		probeCalls.Lock()
		probeCalls.modeSetCompleted = true
		wasClosed := probeCalls.closedBeforeModeSet
		probeCalls.Unlock()
		if wasClosed {
			return windows.ERROR_INVALID_HANDLE
		}
	}
	if fail {
		return windows.ERROR_INVALID_PARAMETER
	}
	return nil
}

func probeSetCommTimeouts(h windows.Handle, timeouts *windows.CommTimeouts) error {
	probeCalls.Lock()
	probeCalls.timeoutSetCalls++
	probeCalls.timeoutSetHandle = h
	probeCalls.Unlock()
	if h != probePortHandle {
		return windows.ERROR_INVALID_HANDLE
	}
	return nil
}

func probeCreateEvent(sa *windows.SecurityAttributes, manualReset uint32, initialState uint32, name *uint16) (windows.Handle, error) {
	return probeEventHandle, nil
}

func probeCloseHandle(h windows.Handle) error {
	if h == probePortHandle {
		probeCalls.Lock()
		probeCalls.closeCount++
		if !probeCalls.completed {
			probeCalls.closedBeforeCompletion = true
		}
		if probeCalls.holdModeSet && !probeCalls.modeSetCompleted {
			probeCalls.closedBeforeModeSet = true
		}
		if probeCalls.holdControl && !probeCalls.controlCompleted {
			probeCalls.closedBeforeControl = true
		}
		if probeCalls.breakArmed && !probeCalls.breakClearCompleted {
			probeCalls.closedBeforeBreakClear = true
		}
		probeCalls.Unlock()
	}
	return nil
}

func probeReadFile(h windows.Handle, p []byte, done *uint32, ov *windows.Overlapped) error {
	probeCalls.Lock()
	probeCalls.readCalls++
	probeCalls.readHandle = h
	retry := probeCalls.readCalls > 1
	probeCalls.Unlock()
	if retry {
		return errProbeUnexpectedReadRetry
	}
	return windows.ERROR_IO_PENDING
}

func probeWriteFile(h windows.Handle, p []byte, done *uint32, ov *windows.Overlapped) error {
	probeCalls.Lock()
	probeCalls.writeHandle = h
	probeCalls.Unlock()
	return windows.ERROR_IO_PENDING
}

func probeGetOverlappedResult(h windows.Handle, ov *windows.Overlapped, done *uint32, wait bool) error {
	probeCalls.Lock()
	probeCalls.waitHandle = h
	probeCalls.Unlock()
	close(probeCalls.waitEntered)
	<-probeCalls.release
	probeCalls.Lock()
	probeCalls.completed = true
	err := probeCalls.completionErr
	probeCalls.Unlock()
	*done = 0
	return err
}

func probeCancelIoEx(h windows.Handle, ov *windows.Overlapped) error {
	probeCalls.Lock()
	probeCalls.cancelHandle = h
	probeCalls.Unlock()
	close(probeCalls.cancelled)
	return nil
}

func probeControlNative(h windows.Handle, flags uint32) error {
	probeCalls.Lock()
	probeCalls.controlHandle = h
	probeCalls.controlFlags = flags
	hold := probeCalls.holdControl
	probeCalls.Unlock()
	if hold {
		close(probeCalls.controlEntered)
		<-probeCalls.releaseControl
	}
	probeCalls.Lock()
	probeCalls.controlCompleted = true
	closed := probeCalls.closedBeforeControl
	probeCalls.Unlock()
	if h != probePortHandle || closed {
		return windows.ERROR_INVALID_HANDLE
	}
	return nil
}

func probePurgeComm(h windows.Handle, flags uint32) error {
	return probeControlNative(h, flags)
}

func probeGetCommModemStatus(h windows.Handle, bits *uint32) error {
	if err := probeControlNative(h, 0); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	*bits = 0x0050 // CTS and RI
	return nil
}

func probeFlushFileBuffers(h windows.Handle) error {
	return probeControlNative(h, 0)
}

func probeSetCommBreak(h windows.Handle) error {
	probeCalls.Lock()
	probeCalls.breakSetHandle = h
	probeCalls.breakArmed = true
	entered := probeCalls.breakSetEntered
	release := probeCalls.releaseBreakSet
	probeCalls.Unlock()
	close(entered)
	<-release
	probeCalls.Lock()
	probeCalls.breakSetReturnedAt = time.Now()
	probeCalls.Unlock()
	if h != probePortHandle {
		return windows.ERROR_INVALID_HANDLE
	}
	return nil
}

func probeClearCommBreak(h windows.Handle) error {
	probeCalls.Lock()
	probeCalls.breakClearHandle = h
	probeCalls.breakClearEnteredAt = time.Now()
	entered := probeCalls.breakClearEntered
	release := probeCalls.releaseBreakClear
	probeCalls.Unlock()
	close(entered)
	<-release
	probeCalls.Lock()
	probeCalls.breakClearCompleted = true
	closed := probeCalls.closedBeforeBreakClear
	probeCalls.Unlock()
	if h != probePortHandle || closed {
		return windows.ERROR_INVALID_HANDLE
	}
	return nil
}
